newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Merchant down on news of fine.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Merchant down on news of fine.

text.p: Shares of investment bank Merchant Bank of Sri Lanka Ltd fell 6.67 percent or one rupee to 14, on news that the company had been fined 139 million rupees by the Controller of Exchange, brokers said.
"Investors are selling the share after news of the fine, as they believe it could have a negative impact on the bank's bottom line," said a local broker.
Merchant Bank was fined by the controller earlier this month over a foreign exchange violation which is supposed to have been committed during the 1995 privatisation of Kotagala Plantations Ltd.
The bank has said it is appealing the decision and the fine.
